async def act(page):
    # Search for issues with 'better' in the title
    search_group = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=page.get_by_role("button", name="Toggle history"))
    search_textbox = search_group.get_by_role("textbox")
    await search_textbox.fill("better")
    search_button = search_group.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after search
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Find the first issue link after search (assuming it's the latest created)
    # Issue links are under the main section and have URLs containing '/issues/'
    # Use get_by_role('link') and filter by checking if the link's URL attribute contains '/issues/'
    issue_links = page.get_by_role("main").get_by_role("link")
    # Filter to get links with '/issues/' in their href using get_attribute and a lambda
    first_issue_link = issue_links.filter(lambda link: "/issues/" in (link.get_attribute("href") or "")).first
    await first_issue_link.click()
